name: BubiBlock Slider
author: Franchi Denis

sections.description:
This plugin is discontinued and is no longer maintained.

Existing installs keep working. There is no replacement in the WordPress.org plugin directory.

If you are starting a new site, choose another Gutenberg slider. Do not install this plugin on new sites.

Powered by

BubiBlock Slider was created by Franchi Design. We use the following open source software:

  • bootstrap
  • animate.css
sections.installation:
1. Go to the Plugins Menu in WordPress
  2. Search for “BubiBlock Slider”
  3. Click “Install”
  4. Activate the BubiBlock Slider
  5. Done!
